## Summary / 摘要

Describe the user-visible or machine-semantic change. / 说明面向用户或机器语义的变化。

## Evidence / 验证证据

- [ ] I ran `pnpm run validate`. / 已运行 `pnpm run validate`。
- [ ] A schema change updates valid and invalid fixtures. / Schema 变化已同步合法与非法样例。
- [ ] A normative prose change updates both language editions with matching section IDs. / 规范正文变化已同步中英文同编号章节。
- [ ] Contract ownership and exact-reference direction introduce neither a second source of facts nor a content-hash cycle. / 契约事实归属与精确引用方向没有制造第二份事实或内容摘要环。
- [ ] Changed generated artifacts were rebuilt and their checksums updated. / 生成产物已重建并更新校验和。
- [ ] Third-party material and AI-assisted assets include provenance and license records. / 第三方材料与 AI 辅助素材已记录来源和许可。
- [ ] No credential, personal data, or confidential deployment detail is included. / 不含密钥、个人数据或机密部署细节。

## Compatibility and limits / 兼容与限制

Name the format family, migration requirement, semantic loss, exceptions, and evidence limitations. / 注明格式兼容族、迁移要求、语义损失、例外和证据限制。
